name: Lilith-Izm07 ~Ore no Pet Hen~
source:
This is the 7th volume of LILITH-IZM! The theme is "Pet of my own"!! Heroines from their popular games are done this and that as a pet! A dog-walking is an option for all girls. Train up Isca, Setsuna, Yozora, Koryu and other girls with strict discipline!

* Magical Girl Isca - interlude -*
Isca has become a "Witch Hunter-Killer." Now in this product, Setsuna and Yozora, 2 girls from the comic version of "Magical Girl Isca - after school.-" join the battle! Strong emotion, fear and sexual pleasure above all attack the girls because of their form of a small girl!

* Special Agent Rei & Fuko: Another Story - Koryu Edition -*
Koryu has failed to capture and brainwash Rei and Fuko, and lost her Shien who served her as her right hand. Her men rebel against her and gets violated by the tentacle monsters that she created by herself. However, that does not enough to make her downcast.
In order to discourage her and let her know her current position, another humiliation starts under the name of discipline...

* Hatsujo Exorcist! : Another Story *
Make that bumptious lady into a obedient pet!? Ryusuke has been working on hunting for the devils with Seika the exorcist. However, one day, her outrageous behavior become too much for him to bear. Aome gives him an idea, and he plans to tame her as a pet!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE080966.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
《LILITH-IZM》第七彈登場！主題是「我的寵物」！來自人氣作品的女主角將作為寵物遭到各種對待，所有女孩都可選擇被牽出去「遛狗」。用嚴格的方式調教伊絲卡、剎那、夜空、黃龍等女孩！

＊《魔法少女伊絲卡》幕間篇＊
伊絲卡已經成為「魔女獵殺者」。漫畫版《魔法少女伊絲卡After School》中的剎那與夜空也在本作參戰！女孩們以幼小姿態面對襲來的強烈情感、恐懼，以及最為猛烈的性快感！

＊《特務搜查官玲＆風子》外傳——黃龍篇＊
黃龍未能抓住並洗腦玲與風子，還失去了作為左右手的紫苑。部下發動叛亂，她也遭到親手創造的觸手怪物侵犯，可這仍不足以令她意志消沉。
為了挫敗她的傲氣，讓她認清如今的地位，一場名為「管教」的新羞辱開始了……

＊《發情驅魔師！》外傳＊
把那個傲慢女人變成聽話的寵物！？龍介一直與驅魔師清華共同獵魔，可某天，她蠻橫的行為終於令他忍無可忍。青女為他出了個主意，他隨即擬訂計畫，要把清華馴化成寵物！

[譯自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE080966.html]英文版DLsite[/url]]
